_: Tear film and free tears: precorneal film ~3 um (aqueous-mucin ~3.3 um under a ~50 nm lipid layer) and the lid-margin meniscus; overflow tears are the same aqueous fluid (more watery when reflex). At ~34 C ocular surface. Built from water.variants.tears plus research. World lane 2026-11-07.

alpha.src: the film smooths the corneal surface optically (the cornea's sharp highlight); a broken-up film is rougher (E)

absorption.v: clear; water-like absorption (negligible at mm scale in the visible)
absorption.src: GAPS 5 water mu_a < 1 per m in 400-700 nm

scattering_length_mm.src: not found: no scatterers resolved; clear film

surface_tension_mN_m.src: TIFFANY91 (Nagyova & Tiffany 1999 abstract re-read 11-08): intact pooled stimulated tears 42-46 mN/m; 53-55.5 after lipid extraction (the abstract states no temperature)

viscosity_mPa_s.src: TIFFANY91 abstract re-read 11-08: marked shear-thinning at 22 C over 2-160 1/s; Cross-model zero-shear viscosity of normal tears 4.4, 7.1, 8.3 mPa s (dry eye 27-31): low_shear corrected from [3, 6] to that range (M); high_shear_blink [1.0, 1.5] is E (not in the abstract; water-like at blink shear)

volume_uL.src: MISHIMA66: E: recalled from Mishima 1966 (~6-7 uL), not re-read (no abstract in Europe PMC; the IOVS page refused 11-08)

production_uL_min.src: MISHIMA66: E: recalled from Mishima 1966 (basal turnover ~16 %/min), not re-read (no abstract in Europe PMC; the IOVS page refused 11-08)

osmolarity_mOsm_L.src: TFOS17: E: recalled from TFOS DEWS II (~300 normal), not re-read

breakup_time_s.src: TFOS17: E: recalled from TFOS DEWS II, not re-read

overflow.v: reflex/emotional tears exceed the drain (~1-2 uL/min capacity); a drop on the lid margin needs ~ > 10-20 uL, then runs down the cheek in a rivulet
overflow.src: ANON_E from volume 7 uL and capillary length 2.7 mm

v.film_on_surface: the film's own thickness (layers / film values)

collision_thickness_mm.src: ANON_E solver convention: a liquid has no skin of its own; it keeps a no-penetration boundary at solids

model.v: incompressible: no stiffness ramp; a pressure projection (or weakly compressible SPH with numerical sound speed >= 10x the max flow speed) keeps it out of solids and out of itself
model.src: bulk modulus (water 2.2 GPa: effectively incompressible at body speeds)

boundary_wetting.v: the contact angle per pair (pairs/world.json wetting) sets the meniscus at a solid

restitution.src: RICHARD02 / DEGENNES04: drops stick and spread on wettable solids; bounce only on (super)hydrophobic ones

response_time_ms.src: RICHARD02 tau = 2.6 sqrt(rho R^3/gamma) with rho 1003, gamma 0.044 N/m

wave_speed_m_s.src: sound ~ water's (CRC; oils ~1450); capillary-wave phase speed sqrt(2 pi gamma/(rho lambda)) at lambda 1 mm

damping_ratio.v: viscous: set by viscosity_mPa_s (no separate damping)

model.src: TIFFANY91 abstract re-read 11-08: marked shear-thinning in all samples

power_law_note.v: treat as Newtonian 1-1.5 mPa s for drop/rivulet motion; shear-thinning matters only in the film between blinks

effusivity.src: sqrt(k rho c) with the values above

reflex.src: ANON_E: reflex tears are more dilute (less protein/mucin)

dry_eye_breakup.src: ANON_E: dry patches roughen the highlight; TFOS17 breakup < 10 s

EYEMD.cite: The project's research note eye.md (F1 tear film 3.3 um aqueous-mucin, lipid 52.7 nm; G1 tear n 1.337; meniscus radius 0.37 mm)

TIFFANY91.cite: Tiffany JM. The viscosity of human tears. Int Ophthalmol 15:371-376 (1991); Nagyova B, Tiffany JM. Components responsible for the surface tension of human tears. Curr Eye Res 19:4-11 (1999). Recalled: tears shear-thinning, surface tension ~42-46 mN/m at 34 C

MISHIMA66.cite: Mishima S, Gasset A, Klyce SD, Baum JL. Determination of tear volume and tear flow. Invest Ophthalmol 5:264-276 (1966). Recalled: tear volume ~7 uL, turnover ~1.2 uL/min, ~16 %/min
MISHIMA66.lic: ARVO archive, free to read; numbers used as facts

TFOS17.cite: Willcox MDP et al. TFOS DEWS II Tear Film Report. Ocul Surf 15:366-403 (2017). Recalled: osmolarity ~300 mOsm/L, pH ~7.4, breakup time >10 s normal
TFOS17.lic: Elsevier open access (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0): numbers used as facts, text not copied

IAPWS.cite: IAPWS releases: Surface Tension of Ordinary Water Substance (2014); Viscosity of Ordinary Water (2008); IAPWS-95 density; thermal conductivity (2011)
IAPWS.lic: freely available releases; numbers used as facts

ANON_E.cite: Estimate made in this lane; the reason is given in each src

RICHARD02.cite: Richard D, Clanet C, Quere D. Contact time of a bouncing drop. Nature 417:811 (2002): tau = 2.6 sqrt(rho R^3 / gamma), independent of impact speed

DEGENNES04.cite: de Gennes P-G, Brochard-Wyart F, Quere D. Capillarity and Wetting Phenomena. Springer (2004): capillary length, Bond number, Tanner spreading

CRC.cite: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics (any recent edition): standard property tables for water, ice, air, oils. Values recalled as standard table values, not re-checked line by line this session
CRC.lic: copyright, paywalled; individual physical constants used as facts, no table copied
